evaluation: Enumerate all exact observed subject/object QIDs and all exact observed predicate PIDs from the union 33-source triple graph, sort numeric. Evaluate every root x predicate1 x predicate2 x terminal QID combination. Bit-weight composition is existential over every supplied QID as an intermediate; each edge uses only F34.contains, never original source rows after programming. Exact symbolic adjacency traversal uses identical 33 triple evidence. No explicit composed-path labels are programmed into bitweights.
truth_definition: True iff exact first-party source graph has witnessed two-hop path; false means absent in this bounded archived graph only, not globally false knowledge.
interference: Program original 13 triples first. Cold snapshot exact. Then program 20 new triples without resetting bits. Require 13/13 old positive memberships preserved, 20/20 new positive memberships; compare cold restored answers to warm. Use no deletion or overwrites.
negative_controls: Exact source identity and SHA256 fail-closed, malformed claim or revision fail closed, shuffled 20 endpoint objects as synthetic negative only, negative graph-path queries absent in bounded source, modified cold snapshot must not be treated as equivalent.
metrics: number of source-positive two-hop queries and path count
